description: This file defines and exports a single function, shapeAgentGroupedSeries, which processes an array of cost record objects to produce a dataset optimized for visualization with Recharts. It groups records by agent and an optional secondary dimension (environment or cost_category), filling in zeros for missing categories to ensure consistent bar grouping.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of raw cost records into a grouped dataset suitable for charting, with optional sorting and categorization features.
